integrity: The standard equations were independently checked in complete open same-object treatments. A complete Rosenzweig–MacArthur cycle-size paper was inspected throughout its model and proof sections, and a complete eco-epidemiological article was inspected where it derives per-capita period averages and states the known mean-prey shift. The new conditional laws and exact defects were independently reconstructed from invariant-measure generator identities and replayed with the packaged checker. Previously published global mean-shift, limit-cycle existence, uniqueness, and size results are explicitly separated from the surviving claim.
scientific_limitations: The invariant measure must be compactly supported in the strictly positive quadrant.
The result is for the standard dimensionless autonomous Rosenzweig–MacArthur model with constant parameters.
The global mean-prey inequality for oscillatory solutions is prior and is excluded from the originality claim.
The theorem does not determine the full invariant density, cycle period, phase distribution, or extrema.
The foundational 1963 full article was not obtained through the lawful full-text routes inspected; its publisher record is used for provenance and date.
title: Fiberwise prey excess and nullcline calibration in the Rosenzweig–MacArthur oscillator
